rationale: The assistant reached the correct hidden cause (no high loop after the sink refit) and gave the right fix, with proportionate safety advice and no fabricated evidence. However it initially downplayed the sink-replacement clue in favour of a generic filter check, then in turn two pointed at blockages and asked for the model number 'to help me find the correct replacement parts' with a parts panel, which was premature when no part was indicated; the customer volunteered the missing high loop rather than being asked about hose routing or timing. It also did not suggest clearing the slow-draining sink trap, a sensible complementary step.
